description: Ambiguous palette: two candidate brand colors with different frequencies (#d90429 x5 vs #1d3557 x3), no role-named variables — exercises frequency-based primary promotion.

colors.note: promoted to primary: most frequent chromatic color
dark navy falls below the chromatic threshold (near-black), so it is never a primary candidate and loses the text role slot to #212529

known_gaps: Second brand candidate #1d3557 is invisible to the ambiguity flow: isChromatic() classifies dark navy as near-black, so only #d90429 appears in chromatic_candidates and #1d3557 is dropped by the role merge.
